title: Projektetage Intro Flow Drag Scale
description: Fix projektetage intro slides 0-6 where dragging text shoots elements out quickly; slide 9 (canvas) works. Root cause likely sectionVisualScale using tall nested reveal stack offsetHeight vs viewport-sized client rect.
summary:
Fixed intro flow drag shooting text across the screen (root cause: pixel vs fraction confusion).

`isFlowPixelOffsetTransform` treated any offset with |x|,|y| ≤ 1 (except 0,0) as a normalized slide frame. A few pixels of drag (e.g. x=0.5) made `flowSectionFrame` apply `left: 50%` on the wrapper instead of `translate3d` on content — huge jumps.

Fix: when measured fractional size is unchanged, x/y are always pixel drag storage. Added `isNormalizedSlideFrame` for the no-measured case. `flowPointerDeltaToLocal` now uses 1:1 screen-pixel deltas.

68 renderer tests pass.
